q: give me a net profit breakdown, waterfall for September 2026
answer:
Net profit for September 2026 (Finance P&L / event-date) was a loss of -₹172,227, i.e. we ran a ~₹172k negative net profit for the month — the P&L lines below show why.

- Biggest drivers (waterfall leaves → net): Gross sales ₹2,253,539 → less discounts ₹110,359, returns ₹371,999 and cancels ₹73,845 = P&L net sales ₹1,697,336. This is the top-line that feeds margin.
- Cost of goods and operating costs subtracted ₹676,241 (product cost ₹553,170 + operating cost ₹123,071 which itself includes shipping ₹76,743, packaging ₹18,237, payment fees ₹12,919 and RTO ₹15,171), leaving contribution margin ₹1,021,095.
- Ad spend (P&L basis) was ₹1,193,322 — larger than the contribution margin and the single biggest reason the P&L went negative, producing the final net profit of -₹172,227.

Worth checking: ad spend efficiency (MER / ROAS) and the return/cancellation drivers — ad spend alone exceeds contribution margin this month, so even modest improvements in ROAS or reductions in returns would move us toward break-even.

Period: 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
